Path: the customer's language | i18n.surface-matrix | P2

## Triage: first grade (family closure card) — `bug` · `priority:p3` · `domain:ui` · `area:i18n` · `pm:queue` (`finding` removed — graded)

Triage: lands in `packages/components/src`: `custom/date-picker.tsx` and `renderers/form/date-picker.tsx` (date-fns `format` with no `locale`), and `ui/calendar.tsx` (`DayPicker` with no `locale`, so date-fns `enUS`) ⇒ `domain:ui`. Rationale: the declared contract, `packages/i18n/src/useDisplayLocale.ts` (「Every date, number and currency renderer goes through here」), is not met by the date faces outside `Intl`. Under a `de-CH` display locale or a German UI, the pickers and calendar captions read English. It was read at source with a lit control (every `Intl` face reads `useDisplayLocale()` since objectui#10442 and objectui#10668) and has no measured `reach:` ⇒ p3, as those two cards. Both are closed, so this card becomes the family's closure card for the date-fns / react-day-picker faces.

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01W89enF2dYV7K4N2Fbfj33f` · 2026-09-27T01:37Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. Read: this card (no comments), the three files and `useDisplayLocale.ts` on objectui `origin/main` `f9c06ef`, `DatePickerSchema.format` (`packages/types/src/form.ts:1100`, `@default 'PPP'`, a date-fns pattern), and objectui#10668's triage comment `5837671436`.

**Why this is not a decision card.** `Governing text:` `useDisplayLocale.ts`'s docblock. It rules out option (c): a face declared locale-fixed contradicts 「every date renderer goes through here」. Between (a) (resolve a date-fns `Locale` from the display tag in one shared place) and (b) (label through `Intl.DateTimeFormat`, captions through `DayPicker` `formatters`), the choice is a mechanism, and it is the claiming seat's technical call under two constraints:
1. `DatePickerSchema.format` keeps its declared meaning, a date-fns pattern, and is still honoured.
2. There is no eager bundle of every date-fns locale.

If the two cannot hold together, stop and report it here, and the card goes to the decision box then. ⛔ Do not pick (c) silently.

**Execution note.** **First, measure** one face: an English UI with a `de-CH` display locale, on the form date picker. Then census every `DayPicker` mount and date-fns `format` call (the form calendar renderer, both pickers, `CalendarView`'s header popover, `DashboardFilterBar`) and give each face the one shared resolution. Pin the measured face and one caption. The `enUS` default under an `en-US` display locale is the control.

Dedupe re-check: every open objectui issue (162), plus the 1000 most recently updated closed issues and PRs, grepped locally for `date-fns|react-day-picker|DayPicker` ⇒ closed or merged work on other faces (objectui#6033, objectui#10377, objectui#10304; PRs objectui#10717, objectui#10420, objectui#10302) and a seat post. No open card covers these faces. No duplicate.
